August, 2023
Author: Vivek Kumar Birla

Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:166430-Db
Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 12963 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashok Kumar Rai,Pavan Kumar Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Mohd Javed Akhter Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mangla Prasad Rai, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Sri Ashok Kumar Rai alongwith Pavan Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioners, Mohd. Javed Akhter, leaned counsel for the informant, Sri G.P. Singh, learned AGA for the State respondents and perused the records.
2.

This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 27.05.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 0130 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 354Kha IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Khakhreru, District Fatehpur.

3. Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents submitted that the charge-sheet No.177 of 2023 has already been submitted on 25.07.2023 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
4. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
